species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 67°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 20–50 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.

species.name: Crappie
why: Water 67°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 16–30 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 67°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 2–22 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.

species.name: Catfish
why: Water 67°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–42 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
